title: 第762章 殿上议事第760章 烟雾蛋
slug: 乱世荒年我每日一卦粮肉满仓
content_zh:
洛京，紫宸内阁之内。
天光疏淡，御案之上摊满各地州府奏疏。
皇帝萧承佑端坐龙椅，神色疲惫，以手撑额，问了一句：“王卿，剿匪如何了？”
一人站出来，拱手奏答：“启禀陛下，各地剿匪已是连战连捷。
至此已剿灭不知多少支叛军，如今唯有三支叛军龟缩于北地一带，不日便可彻底剿灭。”
话音未落，户部尚书张嘴斥道：“王尚书，你简直是一派胡言，叛军数量少了，是因为他们都归了红巾军、赤眉军以及乞活军！
如今这三支叛军已经越剿越多，已快成气候了，你还在连战连捷！”
王弘肃神色如常：“那些叛军被击溃，残部无处可去，投靠别的叛军也是正常。”
“至于匪患越剿越多，那也是因为户部赈灾不力所致。”
说到这，又拱手对着萧承佑：“陛下，天下匪患之祸根在流民，只以刀兵，终究难绝其根。
如今当务之急是救济百姓，安抚流民，让其各回其地，恢复农耕，方能彻底消弭匪患。”
萧承佑微微颔首：“韦卿？”
韦元恒只得上前：“回陛下，若想赈灾，朝廷至少需要拨下百万担粮草，才能勉强维持。”
“可户部已经没粮了，就算是有，各路叛军已经势大，也未必能安稳运到北方。”
又有人说话：“陛下，不如向当地世家大族购粮，赈济灾民，也能节省途中损耗。”
“不错。”
“只是当地粮价已经涨了十几倍，这笔银子还是需要朝廷出。”
“户部没银子了。”
“要粮没有，银子也没有，要你户部有什么用！”
“如今漕运堵塞，朝廷每年疏浚运河征召民夫二十万众，用粮八百万石，布绢三十万匹，户部哪里能有余钱？”

“征发的徭役都需自带干粮、衣物，哪里需要这么多钱粮？莫不是户部从中克扣。”
“我呸.....”
“够了！”眼见越吵越烈，萧承佑一掌拍在桌上：“北方士族就不能先拿一批粮来救济灾民？银子朝廷先欠着！”
此话一出，满朝沉默。
“说话，为何没人说话？”萧承佑额头青筋暴起，目光扫过下方众人。
“陛下，不如暂缓开凿运河，先赈济灾民，安抚百姓。”
“北方士族近几年已在尽力救济灾民，若再逼迫，恐怕再生乱象。”
“朕给他们写欠条，以北地未来数年赋税作保。”
殿上又无人说话。
萧承佑鼻孔重重吐息，许久之后，脸上的怒意才渐渐消退。
往后一靠，抵着龙椅，沉声问道：“运河工事进展如何？只要运河一通，就能缓解南北粮运？”
工部尚书躬身回话：“回陛下，南北运河分段开挖疏浚，南段河道已大体贯通，可通行小型漕船，能够转运南粮北上。
但北段多淤塞、加之民夫匮乏、物料不足，进度迟缓，尚未全线畅通。
如今仅能局部通航，不足以彻底纾解北地粮荒。”
萧承佑沉默片刻，缓缓开口：“朕近期看各地奏折，见北方有一和朔县。
content_en:
Luo Jing, within Zi Chen's cabinet.
The sky was dim, and the imperial case was covered with memorials from various state governments.
Emperor Xiao Chengyou was sitting on the dragon chair with a tired look on his face. He put his forehead on his hands and asked, "Wang Qing, how is the suppression of bandits going?"
One person stood up, raised his hand and replied: "Your Majesty, the suppression of bandits in various places has been a series of victories.
So far, countless rebel armies have been wiped out. Now only three rebel armies are huddled in the Northland area, and they will be completely wiped out in the near future. "
Before he finished speaking, the Minister of Hubu opened his mouth and scolded: "Wang Shangshu, you are talking nonsense. The number of rebels is small because they all belong to the Red Scarf Army, the Red Eyebrow Army and the Beggar Army!
Now these three rebel armies have suppressed more and more people, and it has almost become a reality, and you are still winning consecutive battles! "
Wang Hongsu looked as usual: "Those rebels were defeated and the remnants had nowhere to go. It is normal to seek refuge with other rebels."
"As for the increasing number of bandits being suppressed, that is also due to the Ministry of Household Affairs' inability to provide disaster relief."
Having said this, he raised his hand to Xiao Chengyou and said, "Your Majesty, the root of banditry in the world lies in the refugees, and it will be impossible to eradicate the root with only weapons.
The top priority now is to rescue the people, appease the refugees, let them return to their places, and resume farming. Only then can the banditry problem be completely eliminated. "
Xiao Chengyou nodded slightly: "Wei Qing?"
Wei Yuanheng had no choice but to step forward: "Your Majesty, if you want to provide disaster relief, the imperial court will need to allocate at least one million dans of grain and grass to survive."
"But the Ministry of Finance is already out of food. Even if there is food, the various rebel armies are already strong, so they may not be able to safely transport it to the north."
Someone else said: "Your Majesty, it is better to buy grain from the local aristocratic families and provide relief to the victims, which can also save losses on the way."
"Not bad."
"It's just that local food prices have increased more than ten times, and the court still needs to pay for this money."
"The household department is out of money."
"I don't have any food or money, so what's the use of your household department!"
"Nowadays, water transportation is blocked. The imperial court recruits 200,000 civilians to dredge the canal every year. It uses 8 million dan of grain and 300,000 pieces of cloth. How can the Ministry of Household Affairs have any spare money?"
"The corvee workers must bring their own dry food and clothing. Why do we need so much money and food? Could it be that the Ministry of Household Affairs deducted it from them?"
"Bah..."
"That's enough!" Seeing the noise getting louder and louder, Xiao Chengyou slapped his palm on the table: "Can't the northern nobles first take a batch of grain to relieve the victims? The court owes the money first!"
As soon as these words came out, the whole court was silent.
"Speak, why is no one speaking?" Xiao Chengyou's forehead had veins popping out, and his eyes swept over the people below.
"Your Majesty, it is better to postpone the construction of the canal and first provide relief to the victims and appease the people."
"The northern gentry have been trying their best to relieve the victims in recent years. If they are forced to continue, they may cause chaos again."
"I will write an IOU to them and guarantee the tax payment from the North in the coming years."
No one in the hall spoke again.
Xiao Chengyou exhaled heavily through his nostrils, and after a long time, the anger on his face gradually faded.
He leaned back, leaned against the dragon chair, and asked in a deep voice: "How is the progress of the canal fortification? As long as the canal is opened, it will ease the transportation of grain from the north to the south?"
The Minister of the Ministry of Industry bowed and replied: "Your Majesty, the North-South Canal is being excavated and dredged in sections. The southern section of the canal has been roughly connected, and small canals can pass through it, and can transport grain from the south to the north.
However, due to siltation in the northern section, lack of civilians, and insufficient materials, progress has been slow and the entire line is not yet open.
Nowadays, it is only partially navigable, which is not enough to completely alleviate the food shortage in the North. "
Xiao Chengyou was silent for a moment and then spoke slowly: "I recently read the memorials from various places and saw that there is Heshuo County in the north.
